newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended February 12 rose to $947.28 billion from $944.93 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 658 retail money market mutual funds rose $568 million to $629.49 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 398 taxable money market funds rose $659.7 million to $512.72 billion, while assets of the 260 tax-exempt funds fell $91.7 million to $116.77 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 319 institutional money market funds rose $1.78 billion to $317.79 billion. Of these, assets of the 256 taxable money market funds increased $2.06 billion to $285.85 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds fell $279.7 million to $31.94 billion, it said.
ICI revised last week's money market mutual fund assets to $944.93 billion from $945.09 billion.
